Uttarakhand on 10 July, 2024

Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 250 of 2023
Haleem Khan alias Kunju and another ...Applicants
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand ...Respondent
Present:-
 Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate for the applicants.
 Mr. M.A. Khan, A.G.A. for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
Applicants seek anticipatory bail in FIR/Case Crime No. 711 of 2022, under Sections 3 and 4 of the
Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 and Section 323, 420, 498A, 504, 506 Ipc Police Station Kashipur,
District Udham Singh Nagar.

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the applicants claim that Naushad is their biological son and got him married to the informant.
But subsequently, the informant was harassed and tortured in her in-law's house.
FIR is quite in detail.
4. Learned counsel for the applicants would submit that it is a matrimonial discord; no cheating was done; no dowry was ever demanded.
5. Learned State counsel would submit that witnesses have supported the prosecution case during investigation.
6. Having considered the entirety of facts, this Court is of the view that this is a case fit for anticipatory bail.
7. The anticipatory bail application is allowed.

8. In the eventuality of arrest, the applicants shall be enlarged on anticipatory bail subject to their furnishing a personal bond with two sureties by each one of them, each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO").

In addition to it, the applicants shall also comply with Haleem Khan Alias Kunju And Another ... vs State Of Uttarakhand on 10 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161758998/
1 the following conditions:

entities.text: Haleem Khan Alias Kunju And Another ... vs State Of Uttarakhand on 10 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (i) The applicants shall co-operate with the investigation.
(ii) The applicants shall not approach any witness in any manner, whatsoever.
(iii) The applicants shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) The applicants shall deposit their passport with the AO.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, the applicants do not have passport, they shall give an undertaking to that effect to the AO.

(v) The applicants shall also give an undertaking on (i),
(ii) & (iii) above.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 10.07.2024
